name: Landing Pages
headline: Landing pages built around *one action*.
promise: A single page for one offer or one ad campaign, arranged around one action such as a WhatsApp message or an enquiry. It is the one-page Launch package: ₹7,999, live 2 working days after ready-to-build.

included.title: A page that matches the ad
included.text: The headline repeats what your ad or post promised, so a visitor knows straight away that they landed in the right place.

included.title: One call to action
included.text: Every section points to the same next step. Fewer exits and choices make the page easier to act on.

included.title: Your words, in order
included.text: We arrange your text around the offer: what it is, who it is for, what it costs and what to do next. The words come from you.

included.title: Built for the phone first
included.text: Ad clicks mostly happen on phones, so the page is designed for a phone screen first and checked there before launch.

included.title: Basic technical SEO
included.text: A title, a description and structured data, and the page submitted to Google Search Console. Ad pages often do not need to rank; this keeps the option open.

included.title: WhatsApp and call buttons
included.text: A one-tap WhatsApp chat with a message already typed, and a call button, so an interested visitor reaches you in a few seconds.

process.text: The offer, the ad or post it belongs to, who it is for and the one action you want.
Sections, content and the date are written down; you approve them and make the first payment.
Counted from ready-to-build. You get a staging link to review.
One consolidated round of changes, then the page goes live on your domain.

faqs.q: Why not send ad traffic to my home page?
faqs.a: A home page talks about everything you do. A landing page talks about the one thing the ad offered, which makes it easier for a visitor to take the next step.

faqs.q: Will the page match my Google or Meta ads?
faqs.a: Yes. Send us the ad text and we mirror its promise in the headline. Running and paying for the ads stays with you; ad spend is not part of any package.
For one page, yes: 2 working days from ready-to-build, with one consolidated revision round.

faqs.q: How will I know if the page is working?
faqs.a: Enquiries reach your WhatsApp or phone. Your ad platform reports clicks, and Search Console shows any search visits.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: The offer, the page text, your logo and photos, and access to your domain. Anything missing, we flag before the clock starts.

cta: Send us the offer and the ad, and we will reply with the page plan and the price.
